$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories that are deliberately left in the tree, and why (#337). Read by scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and dev_only (true holds only while `npm audit --omit=dev` does not report the same advisory); an entry that stops matching fails CI so it is removed. Never add one to make CI green without saying what would have to change for it to be fixed. Empty means nothing is being left in: the list is not a place to park an advisory while a fix is found.
